statement_map.email_excerpt: You wanted the autoresponder email to reach the leads coming in from your form.
Following our guidance, you switched on the autoresponder option in your form settings and saved it, and after a test form submission you confirmed the autoresponder email arrived.
We explained that emails can sometimes land in spam, so verifying your sender domain is a good idea.
You can do it in the email domain section of your settings.
Verify your sender domain in the email domain section of your settings (you mentioned doing this the morning after our call).
